answer: The ridge report exposes the merge explicitly at each anchor. Each collapsed cluster gets one willow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an copycat who spins up 282 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 235 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1564 identities would post 4698 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
